text:
jordan: Quick update — PR #19648 (streaming-optimizer) is green on linux but mac-e2e is queued 2/2. Trying to land before Thu midnight deploy-freeze. Need one reviewer and a rebase slot if mac flakes. Can someone ping mac CI owners?

alexa: On it, grabbing review now. Will run local mac smoke in ~10m. @deploy-bot can we reprioritize the mac runner for a short window? :pray:

deploy-bot: CI status: linux/tests ✅ at 2026-03-17T14:02Z. mac/matrix: queued (position 4). No failures yet. To request runner priority add label `priority-merge` or DM #eng-infra.

samira: Added `priority-merge` label and left a quick note on the PR about the freeze window. @infra-team any chance to bump mac for ~30m?

mike: Heads-up — maintenance blackout Thu 23:00–01:00 UTC. If this doesn't land by 22:30 UTC we should defer. Rebase window open until 21:45 UTC.

alexa: Got it. I'll finish review in 15m. If mac flakes we can do quick rebase + rerun — plan: `git fetch && git rebase origin/main && gh pr ready` then trigger CI. After approvals use `gh pr merge --rebase --auto`.

jordan: Thanks — I'll watch CI and tag `merge-window-request` if we need infra help. If mac stays queued >45m I'll escalate to #eng-infra and ask for a manual slot. cc @samira for rollout plan (canary then full).

deploy-bot: Note: rerun limit per PR is 3 within 1h. If CI is stuck after retries, escalate in #eng-infra and include the job URL and runner timestamps.
